entities.name: Tundra Yukaghir
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: The Tundra Yukaghir language is one of only two extant Yukaghir languages. Last spoken in the tundra belt extending between the lower Indigirka to the lower Kolyma basin, Tundra Yukaghir was formerly spoken in a much wider area extending west to the Lena basin.
